comparison.objective: Route a retained cable between posts and seat it in a second clip; candidate transfers an uncaged rigid bearing block between aligned supports.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests bimanual deformable-chain routing, slack management, and clip seating while preserving the first retention. Candidate tests rigid end-face mating and supported linear sliding while containing free rolling bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both clips seated, ordered cable routing through a marked gap, no joint separation, release, and stillness. Candidate requires full block transfer with all balls contained and no support-interface separation, contamination, inclination, or damage.
comparison.reason: Both preserve retention during bimanual motion, but cable routing through clips does not test a rigid carriage crossing a flush raceway junction with loose balls.
